## Analysis

CP-2E Blocked. Macro Risk Level: Insufficient Information for the current Primary scenario. This source-limited fixture claims no current hedge protection or fabricated sensitivity. Search scope: supplied Q2 2026 10-Q, FY2025 10-K, earnings release, credit-agreement amendments/exhibits, 2032 indenture, merger agreement/8-K/press release and synthetic PF capitalisation/term sheet. Historical usable facts remain distinct from October2 current/PF and full prospective-period assumptions. Empty citations follow the Blocked canon.

The 10-Q Note2 discloses no cash-flow hedges at June30 2026 and December31 2025; Item3 reports approximately USD6.0bn long-term variable borrowings, approximately 51% of consolidated long-term debt, referencing Term SOFR/base rate plus margin. FY2025 Item7A separately shows fixed USD5842m and variable USD6063m. These are dated disclosures, not absent fixed/floating or hedge evidence. Neither date establishes the exact October2/PF rate population, future unchanged balances or full-period hedge coverage. CP-1/MODEL carrying debt must stay unchanged; gross debt, approximate variable totals and the synthetic acquisition/new-TLB scenario need explicit period/perimeter/basis reconciliation before calculator input.

FX translation entries in comprehensive income do not establish transaction cash exposure or revenue/cost/debt/EBITDA/cash/covenant currency matching. Operating locations alone supply no natural hedge. Cost/wage inflation and discretionary-spending pressure can weaken margins and cash conversion; no complete annual spend/shock/pass-through/demand-elasticity basis is claimed. Sustainability source reliability, environmental/transition and labor/license exposures, issuer-specific materiality and any KPI/SPT/ratchet/refinancing effect remain evidence-proportionate; missing linked-debt terms do not establish absence or a green premium.

Strongest counter-case: the disclosed dated no-hedge position and variable-rate population permit a bounded historical rate discussion. A reconciled exact scenario population with sourced zero or qualified hedge coverage, floors/terms and horizon could support deterministic cash-interest analysis. Until supplied, the current critical sensitivity remains uncomputed. Rate reset or financing completion -> higher interest -> weaker FCF/liquidity -> refinancing pressure is directional; thresholds and timing require evidence. CP-3/CP-6 receive the limitation and observable rate-reset/financing disclosure trigger; CP-5 retains the source/basis reconciliation gap.

## Gaps

- Critical current/PF rate basis: reconcile exact facility identities, gross/fixed/floating/carrying balances, currency/unit/perimeter, source dates and prospective coverage period against unchanged CP-1/MODEL. Obtain current debt schedule and hedge register or sourced no-hedge statement; do not extend June30 absence or approximate variable debt into a current full-period financial zero.
- Critical sensitivity: source scenario cash-interest terms/floors and full-period effective coverage or explicit zero, then run the strict calculator. Missing amount stays null/Not computable; no partial Combined, invented shock or nonlinear protection. Typed inputs are analyst assertions, never independent source or host-origin proof.
- FX/cost: obtain matched revenue/cost/debt/EBITDA/cash/covenant currencies, net transaction exposures, repatriation limits, annual input/energy/freight/wage/rent spend, pass-through contracts/lags and supported shock/demand response. Separate translation from cash effects and qualify non-overlap before combining channels.
- Sustainability: obtain dated assured/self-reported disclosure, environmental/transition/social transmission, materiality basis, KPI/SPT/test-date/ratchet/reporting-verification terms or supported non-applicability, actual refinancing need and market-access evidence. Keep Insufficient Information distinct from immateriality or adverse inference. CP-6 needs the strongest supported driver/trigger with confidence limitations.
